step4.title: Add a product to compare
step4.body: Click here to add your first gluten-free product. Then fill in the brand, price, weight and store.
step4.hint: You can add one line per gluten-free product you want to compare.

step12.title: Step 12 · Start the comparison wizard
step12.body: Click here to add a comparison line for a gluten-free product.
step12.hint: We’ll guide you through choosing the product type and filling in the details.

step13.title: Step 13 · Choose the product type
step13.body: Pick which gluten-free product this line represents (bread, pasta, cereal, etc.).
step13.hint: When the type looks right, click “Next”.

step14.title: Step 14 · Enter the product details
step14.body: Fill in the brand, price, weight, unit and store. This is what the calculator will compare with your invoice items.
step14.hint: When everything looks good, click “Add line” to save it to this comparison.
step14.saveBody: Now save your comparison so we can use it for the annual report.
step14.saveHint: Click “Save” to go back to the comparison year list.
